tools.name: room_knowledge
tools.description: Check which items/mobs/NPCs/scenery in a room you've already examined (via examine/look at) versus not yet, based on your own past exploration history. Each examined entry includes the actual text the room printed back — reuse that as a remembered clue instead of spending a turn re-examining it. This is a passive record, not a live scan — use the unexamined list to decide whether it's worth going back to inspect something you noticed but never looked at closely.
